title: HKG Package Manager catalog index (format 1)
description: The index.json of a catalog. Unknown fields are allowed everywhere and ignored by readers. See format.md.

id.description: Catalog id; the catalog folder is named the same.

generated.description: When the index was generated, as an ISO 8601 UTC time.

key.description: Fingerprint of the signing key: lowercase hex SHA-256 of the SPKI DER of key.pem.

zip.description: Relative path under the catalog folder (not starting with remote/), or an http:// or https:// URL.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the zip, in hex.

works_on.description: Positive rules: any match makes the package green.

not_on.description: Negative rules: any match makes the package red.

conflicts.description: Package ids that, if installed, count as a negative match.

build.description: Glob (* and ?) matched against the whole ro.build.product, case-sensitive.

hardware.description: Names required present (wifi) or absent (!wifi). Only wifi is defined.
